name: anti-crow
description: Control Antigravity AI from Discord — send natural language tasks, schedule or run instantly, and get results back in real time.
author: lucianlamp

antiCrow.allowedUserIds.description: List of Discord user IDs permitted to process messages. Empty = all denied (security protection). Enable Developer Mode in Discord to copy user IDs.

antiCrow.botToken.markdownDescription:
Bot Token configuration status (encrypted in SecretStorage).

To set the token, run **[AntiCrow: Set Bot Token](command:anti-crow.setToken)** from the Command Palette (`Ctrl+Shift+P`).

This checkbox is automatically enabled after the token is set.

antiCrow.cdpPort.markdownDescription:
Fixed port for CDP (Chrome DevTools Protocol) connection. Used as `--remote-debugging-port` when launching Antigravity.

To create a desktop shortcut that launches Antigravity with this port, run **[Create Desktop Shortcut](command:anti-crow.createShortcut)**.

antiCrow.autoStart.description: Automatically start the bridge when VS Code launches

antiCrow.language.description: Display language for AntiCrow UI and prompts

antiCrow.responseTimeoutMs.description: Idle timeout since last progress update (in milliseconds). 0 = unlimited. Resets automatically whenever progress is reported.

antiCrow.inactivityTimeoutMs.description: Watchdog timeout since last progress update or file event (in milliseconds). Default: 900000 (15 minutes). 0 = disable watchdog.

antiCrow.maxRetries.description: Number of automatic retries on timeout or disconnection (0 = disabled).

antiCrow.categoryArchiveDays.description: Number of days of inactivity before automatically archiving workspace categories (0 = disabled).

antiCrow.workspaceParentDirs.markdownDescription:
Parent directories for creating new workspaces.

Example: `C:\Users\user\dev`, `C:\Users\user\projects`

antiCrow.workspacePaths.description: Automatic mapping from workspace names to folder paths (internal use). No manual editing required.

scripts.deploy: npm run compile && npm run bundle && npm run package
scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run typecheck && npm run bundle
